article_notes: Short communication: 17 dogs with B. canis (smear, PCR-confirmed) admitted to a private small-animal clinic in Warsaw, and 12 healthy controls. Infected dogs split into azotaemic (A1, n=9) and non-azotaemic (A2, n=8) from serum urea and creatinine; criteria not given. Table 1 shows only significant differences; the p values of the A1 vs A2 rows lost their decimal point in conversion and the U values look misprinted. Correlations of disease duration with fractional excretions are not severity associations. Probably overlaps the authors' earlier Warsaw B. canis cohort (Zygner et al. 2012).
